stories.title: Saints' Olave signs extension worth up to $132M
stories.summary: The Saints are signing wide receiver Chris Olave to a four-year extension worth up to $132 million, including $90 million guaranteed, his agents Drew Rosenhaus and Jason Rosenhaus told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Mayfield felt 'disrespected' by Bucs' deal offers
stories.summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield said Thursday that he felt "disrespected a little bit" that he and the team could not reach an agreement on a new contract before his imposed deadline of the start of training camp.

stories.title: Officer opted for no charge against Shanahan
stories.summary: Palo Alto Police said neither party was provided preferential treatment after the July 14 crash that seriously injured Niners coach Kyle Shanahan.

stories.title: Clemens walk-off slam quells sting of '25 selloff
stories.summary: Kody Clemens hit a grand slam with two outs and two strikes in the ninth as the Twins beat the Royals 4-3 after being no-hit by Noah Cameron through six innings.

stories.title: Cignetti: Big Ten proven No. 1, not 'hype machine'
stories.summary: Indiana coach Curt Cignetti, armed with statistical evidence, said the Big Ten doesn't "run a hype machine" and is "the best league in football."
